description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Ezreal''' fires an orb in the target direction that marks the first enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]], epic [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monster]], or [[File:Structure icon.png|20px|link=Category:Structure|An icon representing the keyword Structure]] [[:Category:Structure|structure]] hit for 4 seconds.
description.text: Active: Ezreal fires an orb in the target direction that marks the first enemy champion, epic monster, or structure hit for 4 seconds.

description2.raw: His next [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attack]] or [[File:Champion ability.svg|20px|link=Champion ability|An icon representing the keyword Champion ability]] [[:Champion ability|ability]] against the target detonates the mark to deal them '''bonus''' magic damage.
description2.text: His next basic attack or ability against the target detonates the mark to deal them bonus magic damage.

description3.raw: If the mark was detonated with an ability, '''Ezreal''' restores [[File:Mana icon.svg|15px|link=Mana]] 60 mana plus the mana cost of that ability.
description3.text: If the mark was detonated with an ability, Ezreal restores  60 mana plus the mana cost of that ability.

notes.raw: * The application of ''Essence Flux'' deals 0 [[File:Wit's End item.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Proc damage]] [[:Damage|proc damage]]. ** This triggers [[combat status|in-combat]] effects such as drawing turret aggro and drawing [[Monster#Monster_Behavior|monster aggression]]. ** It also triggers [[File:Sudden Impact rune.png|20xpx|link=Sudden Impact|An icon representing Sudden Impact]] [[Sudden Impact]] and applies [[File:Elixir of Sorcery item.png|20xpx|border|link=Elixir of Sorcery|An icon for the item Elixir of Sorcery]] [[Elixir of Sorcery]]. ** It does not trigger [[File:Cheap Shot rune.png|20xpx|link=Cheap Shot|An icon representing Cheap Shot]] [[Cheap Shot]], however, as [[File:Wit's End item.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Proc damage]] [[:Damage|proc damage]] doesn't trigger [[File:Cheap Shot rune.png|20xpx|link=Cheap Shot|An icon representing Cheap Shot]] [[Cheap Shot]]. * [[File:Spirit's Refuge.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Block]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|Block]] and [[File:Jax Counter Strike old.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Dodge]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|Dodge]] prevents the mark from being triggered by a basic attack. * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] prevents the mark from being triggered by an ability. If the mark is triggered by a basic attack, spell shield will prevent ''Essence Flux's'' damage. * This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
notes.text:
The application of Essence Flux deals 0 proc damage.
* This triggers in-combat effects such as drawing turret aggro and drawing monster aggression.
* It also triggers Sudden Impact and applies Elixir of Sorcery.
* It does not trigger Cheap Shot, however, as proc damage doesn't trigger Cheap Shot.
Block and Dodge prevents the mark from being triggered by a basic attack.
Spell shield prevents the mark from being triggered by an ability. If the mark is triggered by a basic attack, spell shield will prevent Essence Flux's damage.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
